artworks.title: Harbor View
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed etching of a port scene. A large ship with workers handling cargo is positioned to the left, overlooking the harbor. The horizon line is depicted above the ships, showing a fortified tower and a distant island. The etching technique uses fine lines for shading and texture, particularly in the sails and water. The color scheme is monochrome, with various shades of gray. Sparse clouds are visible in the sky, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Windy Harbor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a coastal scene. The horizon line is low, with a small sailing ship on the left and a larger grounded ship with intricate detail on the right. Fine lines depict texture and detail, particularly in the water and ship carvings. The color scheme is monochromatic with sepia and black tones. There is a fort-like structure in the distance with figures by the shore.

artworks.title: Ship in Tempest
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image is captured from a slightly elevated point of view, showing a stormy sea scene. The horizon is above the center, separating the turbulent sky from the rough ocean. There is no object on the horizon. The artwork features intricate linework typical of etching with cross-hatched patterns providing texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a pale background. The waves closest to us are churning violently, while ships struggle. Other vessels are visible in the distance amidst swirling clouds and agitated seas.

artworks.title: Landscape with Waterfall
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from above. The horizon is high with a settlement on cliffs in the distance. The brushstrokes are intricate and detailed, with fine lines and hatch marks creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black and white. Nearest to us, there are animals and a seated figure under a tree. A river flows with waterfalls, leading to hills and structures in the background. Lush vegetation and trees are present throughout the scene.

artworks.title: Landscape with Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene in a detailed style. The horizon is positioned one-third from the top, featuring distant mountain peaks. Two riders on horseback are shown on a path shadowed by large trees on the left. A bridge crosses a small river, with slight ripples shown in the water. Rolling hills covered with trees are depicted in the background, creating a sense of depth. The etching uses a monochromatic palette, emphasizing black shades for contrast and texture in a serene environment. The detailed strokes give movement to the foliage and a realistic texture to the landscape forms.

artworks.title: Landscape with Castle
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image features a low vantage point with the horizon in the middle. A village is situated on a hill with a mountain in the background. The scene is depicted in a detailed etching style with intricate line work and crosshatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic. Two figures on horseback are depicted on a path in the foreground, while rugged mountains are shown in the distance.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Diverses figures et griffonnements"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative architectural design with ornate drapery and text. The image features a richly detailed and symmetrical composition with a central draped banner inscribed with text in a cursive and stylized script. The words are in French, with phrases like "DIVERSES FIGURES ET GRIFFONNEMENTS" prominently displayed in the middle, beneath which "invente et gravez par Stef. de la Bella" can be read. The design includes swirling acanthus leaves and scrolls, which frame the banner on either side, giving the piece a sense of luxurious embellishment. The overall style suggests a fusion of Baroque and Rococo elements, characterized by intricate details and dynamic, flowing lines.

artworks.title: Landscape with Horsemen
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two figures on horseback, one looking towards a large, textured stone structure. In the background, there are trees leaning slightly to the side. The horizon features the stone structure and trees, with additional foliage and a faint outline of clouds. The artwork is created using an etching technique with precise, linear strokes defining forms and textures in black ink on cream paper.

artworks.title: Marine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: The image shows two main subjects across the composition. In the distance, there are remnants of ancient ruins, including a tower-like structure rising above a low horizon. The horizon is positioned in the lower third of the image, highlighting the sky above. To the right of the ruins is a ship with furled sails on calm waters. The style is detailed with fine lines creating texture and depth, especially on the ruins and ship. The color palette consists of shades of black and white with varying stroke thickness for contrast. There is a small bush or mound of earth in the foreground.

artworks.title: Title Page for "Paysages maritimes"
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Sara L. Lepman
artworks.description: This drawing features two large, stylized sea creatures surrounding a central coat of arms. The creatures have prominent eyes and layered scales, and they curl around the coat of arms which is topped by a crown. In the background, ocean waves are visible. Beneath the coat of arms, there is an inscription that reads "PAYSAGES MARITIMES, Faicts par S.D. Bella., et Mis en lumière par Israel". The linework is detailed and intricate, typical of classical engraving styles.

artworks.title: a) The Baptism of Christ; b) Draped Figure Holding a Book and Man Wielding an Ax with a Figure
artworks.medium:
a) pen and brown ink
b) pen and brown ink and black chalk
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch with several figures. In the center, there is a nude figure standing facing a clothed figure with a raised arm. Other smaller and less detailed figures surround them, some sitting or kneeling. The background shows a natural landscape with rocks, cliffs, and a river. The sketch is done in a loose style on toned paper.

artworks.title: Apollo, the Muses, and Mars: In Praise of Tasso
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a gathering with mythical elements and figures, set in a classical or mythological framework. In the center, a nude figure with a lyre stands on a rock, surrounded by elegantly dressed individuals engaged in music and the arts. Some figures are playing musical instruments, while others are in discussion or contemplation. In the upper right, angelic beings with wings hover, one holding a trumpet. To the right, a winged horse akin to Pegasus stands on its hind legs. The background includes trees and a rolling landscape. The drawing showcases precise and delicate lines, indicative of classical or neoclassical draftsmanship.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony [second version]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 35.4 x 46 cm (13 15/16 x 18 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of numerous fantastical creatures in a tumultuous landscape engaged in various activities. The scene features winged entities, a central larger beast with tentacles and wings, creatures in battle with weapons, and a partially ruined stone structure in the background. The drawing showcases intricate linework and shading techniques to create a detailed and intense tableau.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Bridge
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
overall (approximate): 20.5 x 26.9 cm (8 1/16 x 10 9/16 in.)
support: 26.6 x 40.5 cm (10 1/2 x 15 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Ronald S. Lauder
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a bridge, trees, mountains on the horizon, and a seated figure. The bridge is made of stone pillars and wooden planks. The color palette is sepia-toned with a warm and timeless atmosphere. Brushstrokes are soft and sketch-like, giving a sense of movement and texture.

artworks.title: Roche Taillet sur la Saosne proche Lyon
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a historical scene showing a fortified castle or large structure to the left. The structure is on a hill, with walls, towers, and the sky in the background. There are boats on the waters at the bottom of the image, and rolling hills extend into the distance. The sky has swirling clouds drawn in fine lines reminiscent of traditional etching. The color palette is monochromatic, highlighting the detailed line work and creating a subdued, historical ambiance.

artworks.title: Veue du Chasteau d'Ansy le franc du coste du jeu de longue paume
artworks.description: The image shows a grand chateau to the right, set against a clear sky with fine lines that could represent clouds or be blank space. The chateau features classical architecture, multiple chimneys, and intricate rooflines. Detailed etching lines create texture, especially in the foliage of large trees on the left. The color scheme is black ink on light paper. There are figures in the foreground and near the chateau, with more trees and architectural elements visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Veue de la Tour de Quinquangrongne
artworks.description: The image depicts a castle in a landscape, seen from an elevated angle. The castle is the main focus, displaying textured walls in earthy tones. Figures are walking towards the entrance, with a distant cityscape and water visible beyond. Clouds and tree branches frame the background.

artworks.title: Le coin des Bons hommes proche de Paris
artworks.description: The image shows a scene near a riverbank with a high horizon line. A large building complex and trees are visible on the horizon. The fine and precise brushstrokes give detail to the architectural elements and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with black ink and cream paper. Figures walk along a path leading to a stone wall and a small building, while boats sail on the water in the distance. Additional buildings line the opposite shoreline, and there are expansive clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: Veue de la Tour de Grignon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a stone castle on a hill, a horizon line below the center, a sky filled with swirling clouds, detailed etching techniques creating texture and depth, people walking along a path, and a monochromatic color palette of sepia and black.

artworks.title: L'hostel d'Angoulesme
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed architectural drawing of a grand building viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The large structure features numerous windows and elaborately decorated facades. Additional structures can be seen in the distance, offering a sense of depth. The horizon is high, just above the rooftops of the buildings, and stylized clouds are sketched in delicate lines. The drawing technique is meticulous with fine lines and hatching providing shading. The color palette is sepia tones, giving a classical appearance. Close to us are gardens with pathways, trees, and figures engaged in various activities, adding life to the scene. The overall impression is one of elegance and architectural grandeur.

artworks.title: Veue de Pont et partie de la Ville de Grenoble
artworks.description: This image shows an engraved view of a bridge in a cityscape, possibly Grenoble. The view is from an elevated position looking towards the city. The horizon line is low, with mountains in the distance. The engraving showcases detailed line work for the architecture and natural elements. A rocky riverbank is in the foreground with a small figure. A tall tower rises in the city's core, with buildings extending toward the mountains. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly brown and tan.

artworks.title: Le Grotte de Meudon
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon at the upper part. Various elements such as trees, houses, and a building resembling a small palace are depicted in detailed, precise lines, typical of engraving techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic, using sepia tones for contrast. People are visible near the building, with more vegetation and structures in the background.

artworks.title: Veue de Larcenal
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing buildings along a river. The horizon line is visible with rooftops and chimneys. The etching has detailed and defined brushstrokes creating texture in trees and clouds. The color palette consists of sepia or brown ink on pale paper. Close to the viewer are boats on the river with figures. In the distance, there are trees, vegetation, and open fields. The sky has soft clouds.

artworks.title: Veue des bons hommes
artworks.description: The image shows a riverbank with a grand building complex across the river. The buildings, especially the one with a church and steeple, stand out with detailed architectural features. Additional structures can be seen in the distance. The artwork features fine line work and cross-hatching to depict textures. The color scheme is monochrome, similar to an engraving. The foreground includes a detailed riverbank with two small figures, while the sky is illustrated with delicate cloud linework to create a light and airy background.
